app.tagline: Share confidential text, encrypted in your browser.
app.noscript: QuietLink encrypts and decrypts in your browser: JavaScript is required.
app.unsupported: This browser cannot encrypt locally (Web Crypto is missing). Use an up-to-date browser.

size.tooLarge: The text is too large: {used} of {limit}.
sent.title: What is sent to the server?
sent.body: Only the encrypted text and technical data (expiration, read-once flag, public keys). The text, the key in the link and the passphrase never leave your browser.
action.copyFailed: Copy failed: select the text and copy it manually.
disabled.passphrase: Fill in and confirm the passphrase.
disabled.crypto: Local encryption is unavailable in this browser.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.body: Ctrl or ⌘ + Enter: encrypt and create the link. Escape: close a panel or hide the content.
state.deriving: Strengthening the passphrase… (usually a few seconds)
error.network: Connection lost. Your text is still here: retry when the connection is back.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a moment.
error.quota: This instance is temporarily full. Try again later.
error.unavailable: This content is unavailable. It may have expired, been deleted or already been read, or the link may be incorrect.
error.server: The server could not process the request. Try again later.
error.refused: This option is not allowed on this instance.
error.tooLarge: The text is too large for this instance.
error.incompleteLink: This link is incomplete: the key after the # is missing or damaged. Ask the sender for the complete link.
error.alteredLink: This link has been altered and cannot be trusted.
error.integrity: The content failed the integrity check: it may have been altered. It is not displayed.
error.reserved: This content is being opened elsewhere. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
result.title: Encrypted and ready to share
result.encrypted: The text was encrypted in your browser before being sent.
result.careful: Anyone with this link can read the content: send it only to its recipient.
result.readOnceWarning: Do not open this link yourself: it can be read only once.
result.passphraseReminder: Remember to send the passphrase through another channel.
result.qrLabel: QR code of the share link
result.messageReadOnce: Here is a confidential text, readable only once: {link} (expires {date}).
result.leaveWarning: You have not copied the management link. Leave anyway?
manage.title: Management link
manage.warning: This link permanently deletes the content. Keep it private: never share it.
manage.confirm: Delete this content permanently? This cannot be undone.
manage.intro: This page can permanently delete a confidential text. It never shows the content.
read.decryptedLocally: The content is decrypted in your browser; the server cannot read it.
read.revealTitle: A confidential text was shared with you
read.readOnce: This text can be read only once: it will be destroyed after you reveal it.
read.priorOpens: Warning: this content was opened {count} time(s) before without being confirmed. Someone may have read it: consider asking for a new one.
read.destroyed: This content has been destroyed on the server: it will not be available again.
read.leaveWarning: This content will not be available again. Leave anyway?
read.clipboardAdvice: Remember to clear your clipboard after use.
read.consumeFailed: The text is displayed, but the server could not confirm its destruction.
time.clockWarning: Your device clock seems inaccurate; the remaining time is computed from the server time.
how.step1.title: 1. Encrypted in your browser
how.step1.body: Your text is encrypted on your device with a random key before anything is sent.
how.step2.title: 2. The key stays in the link
how.step2.body: The key is placed after the # of the link, a part browsers never send to the server.
how.step3.title: 3. Decrypted by the recipient
how.step3.body: The recipient's browser uses the key from the link to decrypt the text. The server only stores unreadable data.
how.limits: Limits: someone who controls this server could change the page code to capture keys. Use an instance you trust.

read.printWarning: Printing leaves the protection of QuietLink: the paper or PDF copy is not encrypted and may be kept by the printer or the system.
